CURRENT QUESTION:
what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
attempts.response:
```sql
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN donor_count > 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_repeat_donors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT donor) AS num_repeat_donors
FROM (
  SELECT
    donor,
    SUM(amount) AS amount,
    COUNT(*) AS donor_count
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY
    donor
) AS subquery;
```
